entries.name: HepLean.List.takeWile_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma takeWile_eraseIdx {I : Type} (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (l : List I) → (i : ℕ) → (hi : ∀ (i j : Fin l.length), i < j → P (l.get j) → P (l.get i)) →
    List.takeWhile P (List.eraseIdx l i) = (List.takeWhile P l).eraseIdx i
  | [], _, h => by
    rfl
  | a :: [], 0, h => by
    simp only [List.takeWhile, List.eraseIdx_zero, List.nil_eq]
    split
    · rfl
    · rfl
  | a :: [], Nat.succ n, h => by
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.eraseIdx_nil]
    rw [List.eraseIdx_of_length_le]
    have h1 : (List.takeWhile P [a]).length ≤ [a].length

entries.name: HepLean.List.dropWile_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma dropWile_eraseIdx {I : Type} (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (l : List I) → (i : ℕ) → (hi : ∀ (i j : Fin l.length), i < j → P (l.get j) → P (l.get i)) →
    List.dropWhile P (List.eraseIdx l i) =
      if (List.takeWhile P l).length ≤ i then
        (List.dropWhile P l).eraseIdx (i - (List.takeWhile P l).length)
      else (List.dropWhile P l)
  | [], _, h => by
    simp
  | a :: [], 0, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, List.length_eq_zero, List.takeWhile_eq_nil_iff,
      List.length_singleton, zero_lt_one, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, List.get_eq_getElem,
      Fin.val_eq_zero, List.getElem_cons_zero, decide_eq_true_eq, forall_const, zero_le,
      Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le, List.eraseIdx_zero, ite_not, List.nil_eq]
    simp_all only [List.length_singleton, List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.val_eq_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, implies_true, decide_True, decide_False, List.tail_cons, ite_self]
  | a :: [], Nat.succ n, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile, List.eraseIdx_nil, List.takeWhile, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    rw [List.eraseIdx_of_length_le]
    simp_all only [List.length_singleton, List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.val_eq_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, implies_true, ite_self]
    simp_all only [List.length_singleton, List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.val_eq_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, implies_true]
    split
    next x heq =>
      simp_all only [decide_eq_true_eq, List.length_nil, List.length_singleton,
        add_tsub_cancel_right, zero_le]
    next x heq =>
      simp_all only [decide_eq_false_iff_not, List.length_singleton, List.length_nil, tsub_zero,
        le_add_iff_nonneg_left, zero_le]
  | a :: b :: l, 0, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile, List.takeWhile, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, List.length_eq_zero, zero_le,
      Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le, List.eraseIdx_zero]
    by_cases hPb : P b
    · have hPa : P a

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `Fin (r0 :: r).length` and `Fin (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).length`
  according to where the elements map. I.e. `0` is taken to `orderedInsertPos le1 r r0`.
entries.snippet:
def orderedInsertEquiv {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    Fin (r0 :: r).length ≃ Fin (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).length

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_zero {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) : orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 ⟨0, by simp⟩ = orderedInsertPos le1 r r0

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_succ {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n : ℕ) (hn : Nat.succ n < (r0 :: r).length) :
    orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 ⟨Nat.succ n, hn⟩ =
    Fin.cast (List.orderedInsert_length le1 r r0).symm
    ((Fin.succAbove ⟨(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0), orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0⟩)
    ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn⟩)

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n : Fin r.length) :
    orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 n.succ = Fin.cast (List.orderedInsert_length le1 r r0).symm
    ((Fin.succAbove ⟨(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0), orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0⟩)
      ⟨n, n.isLt⟩)

entries.name: HepLean.List.orderedInsertEquiv_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_congr {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (a : α)
    (l l' : List α) (h : l = l') :
    orderedInsertEquiv r l a = (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv.trans
    ((orderedInsertEquiv r l' a).trans (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv)

lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_succ
    {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I) (r0 : I) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : Nat.succ n < (r0 :: r).length)
    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :

lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ

    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv
entries.docstring:
The equivalence between `Fin l.length ≃ Fin (List.insertionSort r l).length` induced by the
  sorting algorithm.
entries.snippet:
def insertionSortEquiv {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] : (l : List α) →
    Fin l.length ≃ Fin (List.insertionSort r l).length
  | [] => Equiv.refl _
  | a :: l =>
    (Fin.equivCons (insertionSortEquiv r l)).trans (orderedInsertEquiv r (List.insertionSort r l) a)

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv_get
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_get {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] : (l : List α) →
    l.get ∘ (insertionSortEquiv r l).symm = (List.insertionSort r l).get
  | [] => by rfl
  | a :: l => by
    rw [insertionSortEquiv]
    change ((a :: l).get ∘ ((Fin.equivCons (insertionSortEquiv r l))).symm) ∘
      (orderedInsertEquiv r (List.insertionSort r l) a).symm = _
    have hl : (a :: l).get ∘ ((Fin.equivCons (insertionSortEquiv r l))).symm =
        (a :: List.insertionSort r l).get

entries.name: HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv_congr
entries.snippet:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_congr {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (l l' : List α)
    (h : l = l') : insertionSortEquiv r l = (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv.trans
      ((insertionSortEquiv r l').trans (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv)

lemma insertionSort_get_comp_insertionSortEquiv {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r]

entries.name: HepLean.List.eraseIdx_insertionSort
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_insertionSort {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    [IsTotal I le1] [IsTrans I le1] :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) → (hn : n < r.length) →
    (List.insertionSort le1 r).eraseIdx ↑((HepLean.List.insertionSortEquiv le1 r) ⟨n, hn⟩)
    = List.insertionSort le1 (r.eraseIdx n)
  | 0, [], _ => by rfl
  | 0, (r0 :: r), hn => by
    simp only [List.insertionSort, List.insertionSort.eq_2, List.length_cons, insertionSortEquiv,
      Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.zero_eta, Equiv.trans_apply, equivCons_zero, List.eraseIdx_zero,
      List.tail_cons]
    erw [orderedInsertEquiv_zero]
    simp
  | Nat.succ n, [], hn => by rfl

entries.docstring:
A structure specifying when a type `I` and a map `f :I → Type` corresponds to
  the splitting of a fields `φ` into a creation `n` and annihlation part `p`.
entries.snippet:
structure Splitting (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (le1 : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] where
  𝓑n : 𝓕 → (Σ i, f i)
  𝓑p : 𝓕 → (Σ i, f i)
  𝓧n : 𝓕 → ℂ
  𝓧p : 𝓕 → ℂ
  h𝓑 : ∀ i, ofListLift f [i] 1 = ofList [𝓑n i] (𝓧n i) + ofList [𝓑p i] (𝓧p i)
  h𝓑n : ∀ i j, le1 (𝓑n i) j
  h𝓑p : ∀ i j, le1 j (𝓑p i)

entries.name: Wick.Contractions.toCenterTerm
entries.docstring:
In the static wick's theorem, the term associated with a contraction `c` containing
  the contractions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toCenterTerm (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic)
    (le1 : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    {r : List 𝓕} → (c : Contractions r) → (S : Splitting f le1) → A
  | [], ⟨[], .nil⟩, _ => 1
  | _ :: _, ⟨_, .cons (aux := aux') none c⟩, S => toCenterTerm f q le1 F ⟨aux', c⟩ S
  | a :: _, ⟨_, .cons (aux := aux') (some n) c⟩, S => toCenterTerm f q le1 F ⟨aux', c⟩ S *
    superCommuteCoef q [aux'.get n] (List.take (↑n) aux') •
      F (((superCommute fun i => q i.fst) (ofList [S.𝓑p a] (S.𝓧p a))) (ofListLift f [aux'.get n] 1))

entries.name: Wick.Contractions.toCenterTerm_none
entries.docstring:
Shows that adding a field with no contractions (none) to an existing set of contractions
  results in the same center term as the original contractions.

  Physically, this represents that an uncontracted (free) field does not affect
  the contraction structure of other fields in Wick's theorem.
entries.snippet:
lemma toCenterTerm_none (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) {r : List 𝓕}
    (le1 : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A)
    (S : Splitting f le1) (a : 𝓕) (c : Contractions r) :
    toCenterTerm (r := a :: r) f q le1 F (Contractions.consEquiv.symm ⟨c, none⟩) S =
    toCenterTerm f q le1 F c S

entries.name: Wick.Contractions.toCenterTerm_center
entries.docstring:
Proves that the part of the term gained from Wick contractions is in
  the center of the algebra.
entries.snippet:
lemma toCenterTerm_center (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic)
    (le : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A) [OperatorMap (fun i => q i.1) le F] :
    {r : List 𝓕} → (c : Contractions r) → (S : Splitting f le) →
    (c.toCenterTerm f q le F S) ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ A
  | [], ⟨[], .nil⟩, _ => by
    dsimp [toCenterTerm]
    exact Subalgebra.one_mem (Subalgebra.center ℂ A)
  | _ :: _, ⟨_, .cons (aux := aux') none c⟩, S => by
    dsimp [toCenterTerm]
    exact toCenterTerm_center f q le F ⟨aux', c⟩ S
  | a :: _, ⟨_, .cons (aux := aux') (some n) c⟩, S => by
    dsimp [toCenterTerm]
    refine Subalgebra.mul_mem (Subalgebra.center ℂ A) ?hx ?hy
    exact toCenterTerm_center f q le F ⟨aux', c⟩ S
    apply Subalgebra.smul_mem
    rw [ofListLift_expand]
    rw [map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem (Subalgebra.center ℂ A) ?hy.hx.h
    intro x _
    simp only [CreateAnnihilateSect.toList]
    rw [ofList_singleton]
    exact OperatorMap.superCommute_ofList_singleton_ι_center (q := fun i => q i.1)
      (le := le) F (S.𝓑p a) ⟨aux'[↑n], x.head⟩

entries.name: FieldStatistic
entries.docstring:
A field can either be bosonic or fermionic in nature.
  That is to say, they can either have Bose-Einstein statistics or
  Fermi-Dirac statistics.

  | bosonic : FieldStatistic
  | fermionic : FieldStatistic

  | [] => bosonic

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect
entries.docstring:
The sections of `Σ i, f i` over a list `l : List 𝓕`.
  In terms of physics, given some fields `φ₁...φₙ`, the different ways one can associate
  each field as a `creation` or an `annilation` operator. E.g. the number of terms
  `φ₁⁰φ₂¹...φₙ⁰` `φ₁¹φ₂¹...φₙ⁰` etc. If some fields are exclusively creation or annhilation
  operators at this point (e.g. ansymptotic states) this is accounted for.
entries.snippet: def CreateAnnihilateSect {𝓕 : Type} (f : 𝓕 → Type) (l : List 𝓕) : Type

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.fintype
entries.docstring: The type `CreateAnnihilateSect f l` is finite.

entries.docstring: The section got by dropping the first element of `l` if it exists.

def tail : {l : List 𝓕} → (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f l) → CreateAnnihilateSect f l.tail

  | _ :: _, a => fun i => a (Fin.succ i)

entries.docstring: For a list of fields `i :: l` the value of the section at the head `i`.

  | [], _ => rfl
  | i :: l, a => by
    simp [toList]

entries.snippet:

    (toList a) = ⟨i, a.head⟩ :: toList a.tail

    FieldStatistic.ofList (fun i => q i.fst) a.toList = fermionic ↔
    FieldStatistic.ofList q l = fermionic

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.toList_grade_take
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toList_grade_take (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) :
    (r : List 𝓕) → (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f r) → (n : ℕ) →
    ofList (fun i => q i.fst) (List.take n a.toList) = ofList q (List.take n r)
  | [], _, _ => by
    simp [toList]
  | i :: r, a, 0 => by
    simp
  | i :: r, a, Nat.succ n => by
    simp only [ofList, Fin.isValue]
    rw [toList_grade_take q r a.tail n]

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.extractEquiv
entries.docstring:

  `f (l.get n) × CreateAnnihilateSect f (l.eraseIdx n)` obtained by extracting the `n`th field

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.extractEquiv_symm_toList_get_same
entries.snippet:
lemma extractEquiv_symm_toList_get_same (n : Fin l.length) (a0 : f (l.get n))
    (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f (l.eraseIdx n)) :
    ((extractEquiv n).symm (a0, a)).toList[n] = ⟨l[n], a0⟩

entries.docstring: The section obtained by dropping the `n`th field.

entries.snippet:

    (eraseIdx a (@OfNat.ofNat (Fin (l.length + 1)) 0 Fin.instOfNat : Fin (l.length + 1))) =
    a.tail

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.eraseIdx_succ_head
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_succ_head {i : 𝓕} (n : ℕ) (hn : n + 1 < (i :: l).length)
    (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f (i :: l)) : (eraseIdx a ⟨n + 1, hn⟩).head = a.head

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.eraseIdx_succ_tail
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_succ_tail {i : 𝓕} (n : ℕ) (hn : n + 1 < (i :: l).length)
    (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f (i :: l)) :
    (eraseIdx a ⟨n + 1, hn⟩).tail = eraseIdx a.tail ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn⟩

entries.name: Wick.CreateAnnihilateSect.eraseIdx_toList
entries.snippet:
lemma eraseIdx_toList : {l : List 𝓕} → {n : Fin l.length} → (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f l) →
    (eraseIdx a n).toList = a.toList.eraseIdx n
  | [], n, _ => Fin.elim0 n
  | r0 :: r, ⟨0, h⟩, a => by
    simp [toList_tail]
  | r0 :: r, ⟨n + 1, h⟩, a => by
    simp only [toList, List.length_cons, List.tail_cons, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.cons.injEq,
      Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    apply And.intro
    · rw [eraseIdx_succ_head]
    · conv_rhs => rw [← eraseIdx_toList (l := r) (n := ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩) a.tail]
      rw [eraseIdx_succ_tail]

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra
entries.docstring:
Given a relation `r` on `I` sorts elements of `MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid I)` by `r` giving it
  a signed dependent on `q`.
entries.snippet:
def koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra :
    MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕) →ₗ[ℂ] MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕)

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra_ofList
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra_ofList (i : List 𝓕) :
    koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra q le (MonoidAlgebra.of ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕) i) =
    (koszulSign q le i) • (MonoidAlgebra.of ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕) (List.insertionSort le i))

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra_single
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulOrderMonoidAlgebra_single (l : FreeMonoid 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :

    = (koszulSign q le l) • (MonoidAlgebra.single (List.insertionSort le l) x)

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder
entries.docstring:
Given a relation `r` on `I` sorts elements of `FreeAlgebra ℂ I` by `r` giving it
  a signed dependent on `q`.
entries.snippet: def koszulOrder : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulOrder_ι (i : 𝓕) : koszulOrder q le (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) = FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_single
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulOrder_single (l : FreeMonoid 𝓕) :
    koszulOrder q le (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid.symm (MonoidAlgebra.single l x))
    = FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid.symm
    (MonoidAlgebra.single (List.insertionSort le l) (koszulSign q le l * x))

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_ι_pair
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulOrder_ι_pair (i j : 𝓕) : koszulOrder q le (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j) =
    if le i j then FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j else
    (koszulSign q le [i, j]) • (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i)

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_one

lemma koszulOrder_one : koszulOrder q le 1 = 1

entries.name: Wick.mul_koszulOrder_le

entries.name: Wick.ofList

entries.name: Wick.ofList_pair

lemma ofList_pair (l r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :

entries.name: Wick.ofList_triple

lemma ofList_triple (la lb lc : List 𝓕) (xa xb xc : ℂ) :

lemma ofList_cons_eq_ofList (l : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :

lemma ofList_singleton (i : 𝓕) :

    (l : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :

entries.name: Wick.sumFiber
entries.docstring:
The map of algebras from `FreeAlgebra ℂ I` to `FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i)` taking
  the monomial `i` to the sum of elements in `(Σ i, f i)` above `i`, i.e. the sum of the fiber
  above `i`.
entries.snippet:
def sumFiber (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] :
    FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i)

entries.name: Wick.sumFiber_ι
entries.snippet:
lemma sumFiber_ι (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (i : 𝓕) :
    sumFiber f (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) = ∑ (b : f i), FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ ⟨i, b⟩

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift
entries.docstring:
Given a list `l : List I` the corresponding element of `FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i)`
  by mapping each `i : I` to the sum of it's fiber in `Σ i, f i` and taking the product of the
  result.
  For example, in terms of creation and annihlation opperators,
  `[φ₁, φ₂, φ₃]` gets taken to `(φ₁⁰ + φ₁¹)(φ₂⁰ + φ₂¹)(φ₃⁰ + φ₃¹)`.
entries.snippet:
def ofListLift (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (l : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :
    FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i)

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_empty
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_empty (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] :
    ofListLift f [] 1 = 1

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_empty_smul
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_empty_smul (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (x : ℂ) :
    ofListLift f [] x = x • 1

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_cons (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (i : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :
    ofListLift f (i :: r) x = (∑ j : f i, FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ ⟨i, j⟩) * (ofListLift f r x)

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_singleton
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_singleton (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (i : 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :
    ofListLift f [i] x = ∑ j : f i, x • FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ ⟨i, j⟩

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_singleton_one
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_singleton_one (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (i : 𝓕) :
    ofListLift f [i] 1 = ∑ j : f i, FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ ⟨i, j⟩

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_cons_eq_ofListLift
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_cons_eq_ofListLift (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (i : 𝓕)
    (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :
    ofListLift f (i :: r) x = ofListLift f [i] 1 * ofListLift f r x

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_expand
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_expand (f : 𝓕 → Type) [∀ i, Fintype (f i)] (x : ℂ) :
    (l : List 𝓕) → ofListLift f l x = ∑ (a : CreateAnnihilateSect f l), ofList a.toList x
  | [] => by
    simp only [ofListLift, CreateAnnihilateSect, List.length_nil, List.get_eq_getElem,
      Finset.univ_unique, CreateAnnihilateSect.toList, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton,
      one_smul]
    rw [ofList_eq_smul_one, map_smul, ofList_empty, ofList_eq_smul_one, ofList_empty, map_one]
  | i :: l => by
    rw [ofListLift_cons, ofListLift_expand f x l]
    conv_rhs => rw [← (CreateAnnihilateSect.extractEquiv
        ⟨0, by exact Nat.zero_lt_succ l.length⟩).symm.sum_comp (α := FreeAlgebra ℂ _)]
    erw [Finset.sum_product]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    conv_lhs =>
      rhs
      intro n
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    congr
    funext j
    congr
    funext n
    rw [← ofList_singleton, ← ofList_pair, one_mul]
    rfl

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_ofListLift
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulOrder_ofListLift {f : 𝓕 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (l : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) :
    koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) (fun i j => le i.1 j.1) (ofListLift f l x) =
    sumFiber f (koszulOrder q le (ofList l x))

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_ofListLift_eq_ofListLift
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulOrder_ofListLift_eq_ofListLift {f : 𝓕 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (l : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) : koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) (fun i j => le i.1 j.1)
    (ofListLift f l x) =
    koszulSign q le l • ofListLift f (List.insertionSort le l) x

entries.name: Wick.OperatorMap
entries.docstring:
A map from the free algebra of fields `FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕` to an algebra `A`, to be
  thought of as the operator algebra is said to be an operator map if
  all super commutors of fields land in the center of `A`,
  if two fields are of a different grade then their super commutor lands on zero,
  and the `koszulOrder` (normal order) of any term with a super commutor of two fields present
  is zero.
  This can be thought as as a condtion on the operator algebra `A` as much as it can
  on `F`.
entries.snippet:
class OperatorMap {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop)
    [DecidableRel le] (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A) : Prop where
  superCommute_mem_center : ∀ i j, F (superCommute q (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j)) ∈
    Subalgebra.center ℂ A
  superCommute_diff_grade_zero : ∀ i j, q i ≠ q j →
    F (superCommute q (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j)) = 0
  superCommute_ordered_zero : ∀ i j, ∀ a b,
    F (koszulOrder q le (a * superCommute q (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j) * b)) = 0

entries.name: Wick.OperatorMap.superCommute_ofList_singleton_ι_center
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_singleton_ι_center [OperatorMap q le F] (i j : 𝓕) :
    F (superCommute q (ofList [i] xa) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j)) ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ A

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteSplit_operatorMap
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteSplit_operatorMap (lb : List 𝓕) (xa xb : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < lb.length) {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (f : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A)
    [OperatorMap q le f] (i : 𝓕) :
    f (superCommuteSplit q [i] lb xa xb n hn) =
    f (superCommute q (ofList [i] xa) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (lb.get ⟨n, hn⟩)))
    * (superCommuteCoef q [i] (List.take n lb) •
    f (ofList (List.eraseIdx lb n) xb))

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteLiftSplit_operatorMap
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteLiftSplit_operatorMap {f : 𝓕 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (c : (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < r.length)
    (le : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ[ℂ] A)
    [OperatorMap (fun i => q i.1) le F] :
    F (superCommuteLiftSplit q [c] r x y n hn) = superCommuteLiftCoef q [c] (List.take n r) •
    (F (superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList [c] x)
    (sumFiber f (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (r.get ⟨n, hn⟩))))
    * F (ofListLift f (List.eraseIdx r n) y))

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_koszulOrder_le_ofList
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_koszulOrder_le_ofList [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ)
    (i : 𝓕) {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ A) [OperatorMap q le F] :
    F ((superCommute q (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) (koszulOrder q le (ofList r x)))) =
    ∑ n : Fin r.length, (superCommuteCoef q [r.get n] (r.take n)) •
    (F (((superCommute q) (ofList [i] 1)) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ (r.get n))) *
    F ((koszulOrder q le) (ofList (r.eraseIdx ↑n) x)))

entries.name: Wick.koszulOrder_of_le_all_ofList
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulOrder_of_le_all_ofList (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ) (i : 𝓕)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ A) [OperatorMap q le F] :
    F (koszulOrder q le (ofList r x * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i))
    = superCommuteCoef q [i] r • F (koszulOrder q le (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * ofList r x))

entries.name: Wick.le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofList
entries.snippet:
lemma le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofList (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ)
    (i : 𝓕) (hi : ∀ (j : 𝓕), le j i)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ A) [OperatorMap q le F] :
    F (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * koszulOrder q le (ofList r x)) =
    F ((koszulOrder q le) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * ofList r x)) +
    F (((superCommute q) (ofList [i] 1)) ((koszulOrder q le) (ofList r x)))

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCenterOrder
entries.docstring:
In the expansions of `F (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * koszulOrder q le (ofList r x))`
  the ter multiplying `F ((koszulOrder q le) (ofList (optionEraseZ r i n) x))`.
entries.snippet:
def superCommuteCenterOrder (r : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A)
    (n : Option (Fin r.length)) : A

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCenterOrder_none
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma superCommuteCenterOrder_none (r : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    superCommuteCenterOrder q r i F none = 1

entries.name: Wick.le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofList_expand
entries.snippet:
lemma le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofList_expand [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ)
    (i : 𝓕) (hi : ∀ (j : 𝓕), le j i)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A) [OperatorMap q le F] :
    F (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * koszulOrder q le (ofList r x)) =
    ∑ n, superCommuteCenterOrder q r i F n *
    F ((koszulOrder q le) (ofList (optionEraseZ r i n) x))

entries.name: Wick.le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofListLift_expand
entries.snippet:
lemma le_all_mul_koszulOrder_ofListLift_expand {f : 𝓕 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (f i)]
    (r : List 𝓕) (x : ℂ)
    (le : (Σ i, f i) → (Σ i, f i) → Prop) [DecidableRel le]
    [IsTotal (Σ i, f i) le] [IsTrans (Σ i, f i) le]
    (i : (Σ i, f i)) (hi : ∀ (j : (Σ i, f i)), le j i)
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A) [OperatorMap (fun i => q i.1) le F] :
    F (ofList [i] 1 * koszulOrder (fun i => q i.1) le (ofListLift f r x)) =
    F ((koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le) (ofList [i] 1 * ofListLift f r x)) +
    ∑ n : (Fin r.length), superCommuteCoef q [r.get n] (List.take (↑n) r) •
      F (((superCommute fun i => q i.fst) (ofList [i] 1)) (ofListLift f [r.get n] 1)) *
    F ((koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le) (ofListLift f (r.eraseIdx ↑n) x))

entries.name: Wick.take_insert_same
entries.snippet:
lemma take_insert_same {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.insertIdx n i r) = List.take n r
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | _+1, [] => by simp
  | n+1, a::as => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact take_insert_same i n as

entries.name: Wick.take_eraseIdx_same
entries.snippet:
lemma take_eraseIdx_same {I : Type} :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.eraseIdx r n) = List.take n r
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | _+1, [] => by simp
  | n+1, a::as => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact take_eraseIdx_same n as

entries.name: Wick.take_insert_gt
entries.snippet:
lemma take_insert_gt {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n m : ℕ) → (h : n < m) → (r : List I) →
    List.take n (List.insertIdx m i r) = List.take n r
  | 0, 0, _, _ => by simp
  | 0, m + 1, _, _ => by simp
  | n+1, m + 1, _, [] => by simp
  | n+1, m + 1, h, a::as => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    refine take_insert_gt i n m (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h) as

entries.name: Wick.take_insert_let
entries.snippet:
lemma take_insert_let {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (n m : ℕ) → (h : m ≤ n) → (r : List I) → (hm : m ≤ r.length) →
    (List.take (n + 1) (List.insertIdx m i r)).Perm (i :: List.take n r)
  | 0, 0, h, _, _ => by simp
  | m + 1, 0, h, r, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, m + 1, h, [], hm => by
    simp at hm
  | n + 1, m + 1, h, a::as, hm => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons]
    have hp : (i :: a :: List.take n as).Perm (a :: i :: List.take n as)

entries.name: Wick.insertSign

entries.snippet: def insertSign (n : ℕ) (r0 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) : ℂ

entries.name: Wick.insertSign_insert
entries.snippet:
lemma insertSign_insert (n : ℕ) (r0 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) :
    insertSign q n r0 r = insertSign q n r0 (List.insertIdx n r0 r)

entries.snippet:

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign
entries.docstring:
Gives a factor of `- 1` for every fermion-fermion (`q` is `1`) crossing that occurs when sorting
  a list of based on `r`.
entries.snippet:
def koszulSign (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop) [DecidableRel le] :
    List 𝓕 → ℂ
  | [] => 1
  | a :: l => koszulSignInsert q le a l * koszulSign q le l

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma koszulSign_mul_self (l : List 𝓕) : koszulSign q le l * koszulSign q le l = 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_freeMonoid_of
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulSign_freeMonoid_of (i : 𝓕) : koszulSign q le (FreeMonoid.of i) = 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_erase_boson
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_erase_boson {𝓕 : Type} (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic)
    (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop) [DecidableRel le] (r0 : 𝓕) :
    (r : List 𝓕) → (n : Fin r.length) → (heq : q (r.get n) = bosonic) →
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 (r.eraseIdx n) = koszulSignInsert q le r0 r
  | [], _, _ => by
    simp
  | r1 :: r, ⟨0, h⟩, hr => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_zero, List.tail_cons]
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.zero_eta, List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.val_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero] at hr
    rw [koszulSignInsert]
    simp [hr]
  | r1 :: r, ⟨n + 1, h⟩, hr => by
    simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]
    rw [koszulSignInsert, koszulSignInsert]
    rw [koszulSignInsert_erase_boson q le r0 r ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩ hr]

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_erase_boson
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_erase_boson {𝓕 : Type} (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop)
    [DecidableRel le] :
    (r : List 𝓕) → (n : Fin r.length) → (heq : q (r.get n) = bosonic) →
    koszulSign q le (r.eraseIdx n) = koszulSign q le r
  | [], _ => by
    simp
  | r0 :: r, ⟨0, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.zero_eta, List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.val_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, Fin.isValue, List.eraseIdx_zero, List.tail_cons, koszulSign]
    intro h
    rw [koszulSignInsert_boson]
    simp only [one_mul]
    exact h
  | r0 :: r, ⟨n + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_cons_succ, Fin.isValue,
      List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]
    intro h'
    rw [koszulSign, koszulSign, koszulSign_erase_boson q le r ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩]
    congr 1
    rw [koszulSignInsert_erase_boson q le r0 r ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩ h']
    exact h'

entries.name: Wick.koszulSign_insertIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSign_insertIdx [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (i : 𝓕) :
    (r : List 𝓕) → (n : ℕ) → (hn : n ≤ r.length) →
    koszulSign q le (List.insertIdx n i r) = insertSign q n i r * koszulSign q le r *
      insertSign q (insertionSortEquiv le (List.insertIdx n i r) ⟨n, by
        rw [List.length_insertIdx _ _ hn]
        omega⟩) i (List.insertionSort le (List.insertIdx n i r))
  | [], 0, h => by
    simp [koszulSign, insertSign, superCommuteCoef, koszulSignInsert]
  | [], n + 1, h => by
    simp at h
  | r0 :: r, 0, h => by
    simp only [List.insertIdx_zero, List.insertionSort, List.length_cons, Fin.zero_eta]
    rw [koszulSign]
    trans koszulSign q le (r0 :: r) * koszulSignInsert q le i (r0 :: r)
    ring
    simp only [insertionSortEquiv, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.insertionSort,
      orderedInsertEquiv, OrderIso.toEquiv_symm, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, HepLean.Fin.equivCons_trans,
      Equiv.trans_apply, HepLean.Fin.equivCons_zero, HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_apply_eq,
      Fin.isValue, HepLean.Fin.finExtractOne_symm_inl_apply, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv,
      Fin.castOrderIso_apply, Fin.cast_mk, Fin.eta]
    conv_rhs =>
      rhs
      rhs
      rw [orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_orderedInsertPos]
    conv_rhs =>
      rhs
      rw [← insertSign_insert]
      change insertSign q (↑(orderedInsertPos le ((List.insertionSort le (r0 :: r))) i)) i
        (List.insertionSort le (r0 :: r))
      rw [← koszulSignInsert_eq_insertSign q le]
    rw [insertSign_zero]
    simp
  | r0 :: r, n + 1, h => by
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [List.insertIdx_succ_cons]
      rw [koszulSign]
    rw [koszulSign_insertIdx]
    conv_rhs =>
      rhs
      simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons]

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert
entries.docstring:
Gives a factor of `-1` when inserting `a` into a list `List I` in the ordered position
  for each fermion-fermion cross.
entries.snippet:
def koszulSignInsert {𝓕 : Type} (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop)
    [DecidableRel le] (a : 𝓕) : List 𝓕 → ℂ
  | [] => 1
  | b :: l => if le a b then koszulSignInsert q le a l else
    if q a = fermionic ∧ q b = fermionic then - koszulSignInsert q le a l else
      koszulSignInsert q le a l

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_boson
entries.docstring: When inserting a boson the `koszulSignInsert` is always `1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_boson (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (le : 𝓕 → 𝓕 → Prop) [DecidableRel le]
    (a : 𝓕) (ha : q a = bosonic) : (l : List 𝓕) → koszulSignInsert q le a l = 1
  | [] => by
    simp [koszulSignInsert]
  | b :: l => by
    simp only [koszulSignInsert, Fin.isValue, ite_eq_left_iff]
    rw [koszulSignInsert_boson q le a ha l, ha]
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte, ite_self]

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_mul_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma koszulSignInsert_mul_self (a : 𝓕) :
    (l : List 𝓕) → koszulSignInsert q le a l * koszulSignInsert q le a l = 1
  | [] => by
    simp [koszulSignInsert]
  | b :: l => by
    simp only [koszulSignInsert, Fin.isValue, mul_ite, ite_mul, neg_mul, mul_neg]
    by_cases hr : le a b
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [koszulSignInsert_mul_self]
    · simp only [hr, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hq : q a = fermionic ∧ q b = fermionic
      · simp only [hq, and_self, ↓reduceIte, neg_neg]
        rw [koszulSignInsert_mul_self]
      · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [koszulSignInsert_mul_self]

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_le_forall
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_le_forall (a : 𝓕) (l : List 𝓕) (hi : ∀ b, le a b) :
    koszulSignInsert q le a l = 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_ge_forall_append
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_ge_forall_append (l : List 𝓕) (j i : 𝓕) (hi : ∀ j, le j i) :
    koszulSignInsert q le j l = koszulSignInsert q le j (l ++ [i])

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_filter
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_filter (r0 : 𝓕) : (r : List 𝓕) →
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 r =
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 (List.filter (fun i => decide (¬ le r0 i)) r)
  | [] => by
    simp [koszulSignInsert]
  | r1 :: r => by
    dsimp only [koszulSignInsert, Fin.isValue]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, List.filter, decide_not]
    by_cases h : le r0 r1
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, decide_True, Bool.not_true]
      rw [koszulSignInsert_eq_filter]
      congr
      simp
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue, decide_False, Bool.not_false]
      dsimp only [Fin.isValue, koszulSignInsert]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, h, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [koszulSignInsert_eq_filter]
      congr
      simp only [decide_not]
      simp

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_cons [IsTotal 𝓕 le] (r0 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 r = koszulSignInsert q le r0 (r0 :: r)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_grade
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_grade (r0 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 r = if ofList q [r0] = fermionic ∧
    ofList q (List.filter (fun i => decide (¬ le r0 i)) r) = fermionic then -1 else 1

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_perm (r r' : List 𝓕) (a : 𝓕) (h : r.Perm r') :
    koszulSignInsert q le a r = koszulSignInsert q le a r'

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_sort
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_sort (r : List 𝓕) (a : 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le a r = koszulSignInsert q le a (List.insertionSort le r)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_insertSign
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_eq_insertSign [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (r0 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 r = insertSign q (orderedInsertPos le (List.insertionSort le r) r0)
      r0 (List.insertionSort le r)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_insertIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_insertIdx (i j : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ r.length) :
    koszulSignInsert q le j (List.insertIdx n i r) = koszulSignInsert q le j (i :: r)

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignCons
entries.docstring:
The difference in `koszulSignInsert` on inserting `r0` into `r` compared to
  into `r1 :: r` for any `r`.
entries.snippet: def koszulSignCons (r0 r1 : 𝓕) : ℂ

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignCons_eq_superComuteCoef
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignCons_eq_superComuteCoef (r0 r1 : 𝓕) : koszulSignCons q le r0 r1 =
    if le r0 r1 then 1 else superCommuteCoef q [r0] [r1]

entries.name: Wick.koszulSignInsert_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma koszulSignInsert_cons (r0 r1 : 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) :
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 (r1 :: r) = (koszulSignCons q le r0 r1) *
    koszulSignInsert q le r0 r

entries.name: Wick.staticWickCoef
entries.docstring:
The sign that appears in the static version of Wicks theorem.
  This is actually equal to `superCommuteCoef q [r.get n] (r.take n)`, something
  which will be proved in a lemma.
entries.snippet: def staticWickCoef (r : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕) (n : Fin r.length) : ℂ

entries.name: Wick.staticWickCoef_eq_q
entries.snippet:
lemma staticWickCoef_eq_q (r : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕) (n : Fin r.length)
    (hq : q i = q (r.get n)) :
    staticWickCoef q le r i n =
    koszulSign q le r *
    superCommuteCoef q [r.get n] (List.take (↑(insertionSortEquiv le r n))
      (List.insertionSort le r)) *
    koszulSign q le (r.eraseIdx ↑n)

entries.name: Wick.insertIdx_eraseIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma insertIdx_eraseIdx {I : Type} : (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) → (hn : n < r.length) →
    List.insertIdx n (r.get ⟨n, hn⟩) (r.eraseIdx n) = r
  | n, [], hn => by
    simp at hn
  | 0, r0 :: r, hn => by
    simp
  | n + 1, r0 :: r, hn => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_cons_succ,
      List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
    exact insertIdx_eraseIdx n r _

entries.name: Wick.staticWickCoef_eq_get
entries.snippet:
lemma staticWickCoef_eq_get [IsTotal 𝓕 le] [IsTrans 𝓕 le] (r : List 𝓕) (i : 𝓕) (n : Fin r.length)
    (heq : q i = q (r.get n)) :
    staticWickCoef q le r i n = superCommuteCoef q [r.get n] (r.take n)

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef
entries.docstring:
Given two lists `la` and `lb` returns `-1` if they are both of grade `1` and
  `1` otherwise. This corresponds to the sign associated with the super commutator
  when commuting `la` and `lb` in the free algebra.
  In terms of physics it is `-1` if commuting two fermionic operators and `1` otherwise.
entries.snippet: def superCommuteCoef (la lb : List 𝓕) : ℂ

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_comm
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_comm (la lb : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteCoef q la lb = superCommuteCoef q lb la

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteLiftCoef
entries.docstring:
Given a list `l : List (Σ i, f i)` and a list `r : List I` returns `-1` if the
  grade of `l` is `1` and the grade of `r` is `1` and `1` otherwise. This corresponds
  to the sign associated with the super commutator when commuting
  the lift of `l` and `r` (by summing over fibers) in the
  free algebra over `Σ i, f i`.
  In terms of physics it is `-1` if commuting two fermionic operators and `1` otherwise.
entries.snippet: def superCommuteLiftCoef {f : 𝓕 → Type} (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) : ℂ

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteLiftCoef_empty
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteLiftCoef_empty {f : 𝓕 → Type} (l : List (Σ i, f i)) :
    superCommuteLiftCoef q l [] = 1

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_perm_snd
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_perm_snd (la lb lb' : List 𝓕)
    (h : lb.Perm lb') :
    superCommuteCoef q la lb = superCommuteCoef q la lb'

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_mul_self
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_mul_self (l lb : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteCoef q l lb * superCommuteCoef q l lb = 1

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_empty
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_empty (la : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteCoef q la [] = 1

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_append
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_append (la lb lc : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteCoef q la (lb ++ lc) = superCommuteCoef q la lb * superCommuteCoef q la lc

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteCoef_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommuteCoef_cons (i : 𝓕) (la lb : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteCoef q la (i :: lb) = superCommuteCoef q la [i] * superCommuteCoef q la lb

entries.name: Wick.static_wick_nil
entries.snippet:
lemma static_wick_nil {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A)
    (S : Contractions.Splitting f le) :
    F (ofListLift f [] 1) = ∑ c : Contractions [],
    c.toCenterTerm f q le F S *
    F (koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le (ofListLift f c.normalize 1))

entries.name: Wick.static_wick_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma static_wick_cons [IsTrans ((i : 𝓕) × f i) le] [IsTotal ((i : 𝓕) × f i) le]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (r : List 𝓕) (a : 𝓕)
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A) [OperatorMap (fun i => q i.1) le F]
    (S : Contractions.Splitting f le)
    (ih : F (ofListLift f r 1) =
    ∑ c : Contractions r, c.toCenterTerm f q le F S * F (koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le
      (ofListLift f c.normalize 1))) :
    F (ofListLift f (a :: r) 1) = ∑ c : Contractions (a :: r),
      c.toCenterTerm f q le F S *
      F (koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le (ofListLift f c.normalize 1))

entries.name: Wick.static_wick_theorem
entries.snippet:
theorem static_wick_theorem [IsTrans ((i : 𝓕) × f i) le] [IsTotal ((i : 𝓕) × f i) le]
    {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (r : List 𝓕)
    (F : FreeAlgebra ℂ (Σ i, f i) →ₐ A) [OperatorMap (fun i => q i.1) le F]
    (S : Contractions.Splitting f le) :
    F (ofListLift f r 1) = ∑ c : Contractions r, c.toCenterTerm f q le F S *
    F (koszulOrder (fun i => q i.fst) le (ofListLift f c.normalize 1))

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteMonoidAlgebra
entries.docstring:
Given a grading `q : I → Fin 2` and a list `l : List I` the super-commutor on the free algebra
  `FreeAlgebra ℂ I` corresponding to commuting with `l`
  as a linear map from `MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid I)` (the module of lists in `I`)
  to itself.
entries.snippet:
def superCommuteMonoidAlgebra (l : List 𝓕) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕) →ₗ[ℂ] MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕)

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteAlgebra
entries.docstring:
Given a grading `q : I → Fin 2` the super-commutor on the free algebra `FreeAlgebra ℂ I`
  as a linear map from `MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid I)` (the module of lists in `I`)
  to `FreeAlgebra ℂ I →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ I`.
entries.snippet:
def superCommuteAlgebra :
    MonoidAlgebra ℂ (FreeMonoid 𝓕) →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕

entries.name: Wick.superCommute
entries.docstring:
Given a grading `q : I → Fin 2` the super-commutor on the free algebra `FreeAlgebra ℂ I`
  as a bi-linear map.
entries.snippet:
def superCommute :
    FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕

entries.name: Wick.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid_freeAlgebra
entries.snippet:
lemma equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid_freeAlgebra {I : Type} (i : I) :
    (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i)) =
    Finsupp.single (FreeMonoid.of i) 1

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ι
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma superCommute_ι (i j : 𝓕) :
    superCommute q (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j) =
    FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j +
    if q i = fermionic ∧ q j = fermionic then
      FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i
    else
      - FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ j * FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ i

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofList
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofList (l r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    superCommute q (ofList l x) (ofList r y) =
    ofList (l ++ r) (x * y) + (if FieldStatistic.ofList q l = fermionic ∧
      FieldStatistic.ofList q r = fermionic then
    ofList (r ++ l) (y * x) else - ofList (r ++ l) (y * x))

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma superCommute_zero (a : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕) :
    superCommute q a 0 = 0

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma superCommute_one (a : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕) :
    superCommute q a 1 = 0

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_mul
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_mul (la lb lc : List 𝓕) (xa xb xc : ℂ) :
    superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb * ofList lc xc) =
    (superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb) * ofList lc xc +
    superCommuteCoef q la lb • ofList lb xb * superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lc xc))

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteSplit
entries.docstring:
Given two lists `la lb : List I`, in the expansion of the supercommutor of `la` and `lb`
  via elements of `lb`the term associated with the `n`th element.
  E.g. in the commutator
  `[a, bc] = [a, b] c + b [a, c] ` the `superCommuteSplit` for `n=0` is `[a, b] c`
  and for `n=1` is `b [a, c]`.

def superCommuteSplit (la lb : List 𝓕) (xa xb : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < lb.length) : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_cons (la lb : List 𝓕) (xa xb : ℂ) (b1 : 𝓕) :
    superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList (b1 :: lb) xb) =
    superCommute q (ofList la xa) (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ b1) * ofList lb xb +
    superCommuteCoef q la [b1] •
    (ofList [b1] 1) * superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb)

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_sum (la lb : List 𝓕) (xa xb : ℂ) :
    superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb) =
    ∑ (n : Fin lb.length), superCommuteSplit q la lb xa xb n n.prop

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofList_superCommuteCoef
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofList_superCommuteCoef (la lb : List 𝓕)
    (xa xb : ℂ) : superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb) =
    ofList la xa * ofList lb xb - superCommuteCoef q la lb • ofList lb xb * ofList la xa

entries.name: Wick.ofList_ofList_superCommute
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_ofList_superCommute (la lb : List 𝓕) (xa xb : ℂ) :
    ofList la xa * ofList lb xb = superCommuteCoef q la lb • ofList lb xb * ofList la xa
    + superCommute q (ofList la xa) (ofList lb xb)

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_ofList_superCommute'
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_ofList_superCommute' (l : List 𝓕) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    ofList r y * ofList l x = superCommuteCoef q l r • (ofList l x * ofList r y)
    - superCommuteCoef q l r • superCommute q (ofList l x) (ofList r y)

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofListLift
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofListLift (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f r y) =
    ofList l x * ofListLift f r y +
    (if FieldStatistic.ofList (fun i => q i.1) l = fermionic ∧
      FieldStatistic.ofList q r = fermionic then
    ofListLift f r y * ofList l x else - ofListLift f r y * ofList l x)

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_superCommuteLiftCoef
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_superCommuteLiftCoef
    (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f r y) =
    ofList l x * ofListLift f r y - superCommuteLiftCoef q l r • ofListLift f r y * ofList l x

entries.name: Wick.ofList_ofListLift_superCommute
entries.snippet:
lemma ofList_ofListLift_superCommute (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    ofList l x * ofListLift f r y = superCommuteLiftCoef q l r • ofListLift f r y * ofList l x
    + superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f r y)

entries.name: Wick.ofListLift_ofList_superCommute
entries.snippet:
lemma ofListLift_ofList_superCommute (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    ofListLift f r y * ofList l x = superCommuteLiftCoef q l r • (ofList l x * ofListLift f r y)
    - superCommuteLiftCoef q l r •
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f r y)

entries.name: Wick.superCommuteLiftCoef_append

lemma superCommuteLiftCoef_append (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r1 r2 : List 𝓕) :
    superCommuteLiftCoef q l (r1 ++ r2) =
    superCommuteLiftCoef q l r1 * superCommuteLiftCoef q l r2

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_cons (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) (b1 : 𝓕) :
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f (b1 :: r) y) =
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (sumFiber f (FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ b1))
    * ofListLift f r y + superCommuteLiftCoef q l [b1] •

entries.name: Wick.superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_sum
entries.snippet:
lemma superCommute_ofList_ofListLift_sum (l : List (Σ i, f i)) (r : List 𝓕) (x y : ℂ) :
    superCommute (fun i => q i.1) (ofList l x) (ofListLift f r y) =
    ∑ (n : Fin r.length), superCommuteLiftSplit q l r x y n n.prop
